Quebec Court Authorizes Class Action Against Spa Over Sexual Assault Allegations

Quebec's Superior Court has authorized a class-action lawsuit against Nordik Spa Village, alleging sexual assault by at least 36 massage therapists. The allegations span incidents reported to have occurred between 2007 and 2026, with over 140 individuals joining the suit.
